generic foreign key) reuse ``_broker_client_ids`` and apply their own filter.

The data connection object represents the state of a data connection in
a third-party system, which has been initiated by sending the loan request
information from Oper to the third-party system. Such an object is
initially created by Oper, for example when the loan request is sent to
a lender, at the user's request. As soon as the user triggers the event,
a new process is started with its own data connection object.

Through this route, a third party system can view a specific loan request

the allowed variabilities configured for the product.
